# CI constraints: pin the framework stack to the versions the adapter
# integration tests are verified against. A fresh `pip install .[all]` resolves
# the newest LangChain/LangGraph/CrewAI/OpenAI-Agents, which are not the
# versions the adapters hook, so CI must use these exact pins.
#
# Rationale for the tricky ones:
# - openai-agents 0.6.0 accepts openai<3, which is what keeps CrewAI's `openai<3`
#   pin and OpenAI Agents importable in the same environment.
# - transformers 5.0.0 is the release that still accepts torch 2.5.1.

pydantic==2.12.5
numpy==2.0.1
faiss-cpu==1.15.1
tenacity==9.2.1

sentence-transformers==6.1.0
torch==2.5.1
transformers==5.0.0
tokenizers==0.22.2
huggingface-hub==1.33.0

langchain==1.4.7
langchain-core==1.7.0
langgraph==1.2.17
langgraph-checkpoint==4.3.0
langgraph-prebuilt==1.1.1
langgraph-sdk==0.4.9

openai==2.54.0
openai-agents==0.6.0

crewai==1.15.30
crewai-cli==1.15.30
crewai-core==1.15.30
